records.title: Binance verified News update: deposits normal, withdrawals paused
records.note: The verified Binance News account says deposits are operating normally while withdrawals remain paused during a security overhaul, with restoration expected within 48 hours. The indexed result does not expose an exact publication time or per-network status. This differs from Binance Support's 2026-10-30 02:23 UTC security update, which said deposits and withdrawals were temporarily suspended. Treat as a status-snapshot discrepancy; do not infer all networks or products are restored.
